anchors.quote: Exposure is the sum of the amounts of eligible holdings in the complete inventory. Ineligible holdings contribute zero. An empty complete inventory has zero exposure. Negative amounts are permitted. Each item represents a distinct position; do not deduplicate equal values.

interpretation: Exposure is the sum of the amounts of eligible holdings in the complete inventory. Ineligible holdings contribute zero. An empty complete inventory has zero exposure. Negative amounts are permitted. Each item represents a distinct position; do not deduplicate equal values.
source:
```catala
scope Portfolio:
  definition exposure equals sum decimal of (map each h among holdings to if h.eligible then h.amount else 0.0)
```
